tokens.name: qt-dark
tokens.usage: Brand navy — source `qt-dark` (tailwind.config.ts), the panel fill. Constant in both themes; paint with `surface-raised` (its Dark alias) or `ink` (its Light role), not with this directly.

tokens.name: qt-darker
tokens.usage: Brand night — source `qt-darker`, the page fill and chart-tooltip fill. Constant; reached through `surface`, `surface-overlay` and the Dark `on-*` text tokens.

tokens.name: qt-accent
tokens.usage: Brand cyan — source `qt-accent`. Constant; reached through `accent` in Dark. 1.7:1 on white: never raw on Light surfaces.

tokens.name: qt-accent-alt
tokens.usage: Brand violet — source `qt-accent-alt` (the timeframe selector). Constant; reached through `accent-alt`. 4.49:1 on `qt-dark` (a hair under 4.5): borders, fills and marks, not small text on panels.

tokens.name: qt-buy
tokens.usage: Source `qt-buy` — BUY text and the connected dot. Constant; reached through `bull` and `ok` in Dark. 1.4:1 on white: never raw on Light surfaces.

tokens.name: qt-sell
tokens.usage: Source `qt-sell` — SELL text and CRITICAL alerts. Constant; reached through `bear` and `danger` in Dark. Against `qt-buy` the lightness ratio is only 2.6:1, so buy and sell always carry an icon and a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: qt-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Source scrollbar-thumb hover (globals.css). Constant; reached through `accent-hover` in Dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels. Dark is the source body fill (`qt-darker`); Light is a cool paper tinted toward the brand navy.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tickets and the chart plot (source `bg-qt-dark`). The two surfaces differ by only 1.05:1 in Dark on purpose: `line` borders carry the structure, not elevation.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus and popovers (Dark is the source chart-tooltip fill). Always with a `line-control` border and `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows and cards (source `hover:bg-qt-accent/5`). A tint: layer it over `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected segment or row (source `bg-qt-accent/20`); pair it with an `accent` border. `ink` and `ink-muted` both hold on it.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of icon buttons and resting controls (source `hover:bg-qt-accent/10`).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders and dividers (source `.panel-border`, `border-qt-accent/20`). Decorative — below 3:1, so never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Card borders inside panels (source `border-qt-accent/30`). Decorative. The source also drew resting chips with it, where it reads about 2:1 — controls use `line-control`.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Resting border of every interactive control — segments, buttons, the kill switch. At least 3.3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes; Dark is the source hover border (`border-qt-accent/50`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, tint and soft fill (Dark is the source body white; Light reuses the brand navy).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — meta, field labels, timestamps, empty states, axis ticks — on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover` and `surface-selected` (4.5:1 or more everywhere; tightest on `surface-selected`: 5.0:1 Dark, 4.6:1 Light). Replaces the source's cyan-at-50–70% text, whose 50% step read 3.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only (WCAG-exempt), about 3:1 on the surfaces. Never for information a trader needs to act on.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive accent: panel titles, selected borders, links, the focus ring, the primary button fill and the price line. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover` and `accent-soft`. Light keeps the brand hue (OKLCH 216.5), deepened to 5.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: info and in-progress badges (VALIDATING, RECEIVED).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (the primary button). Dark uses `qt-darker`: white on cyan is only 1.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for time context: the selected timeframe border, series 2. Not for text on `surface-raised` in Dark (4.49:1); fine as a border or mark (3:1+) in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-alt-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected timeframe segment (source `bg-qt-accent-alt/20`); text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: bull
tokens.usage: Long/BUY direction, up moves, positive P&L — always beside the trending-up icon or the word. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `bull-soft`.

tokens.name: bull-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind bull text: BUY badges, positive P&L cells.

tokens.name: on-bull
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `bull` fill (the chart BUY marker).

tokens.name: bear
tokens.usage: Short/SELL direction, down moves, negative P&L — always beside the trending-down icon or the word. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `bear-soft`.

tokens.name: bear-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind bear text; also the drawdown area wash under a `bear` line.

tokens.name: on-bear
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `bear` fill (the chart SELL marker).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, passed, approved — an alias of `bull` (the source's connected dot is `qt-buy`). Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text: APPROVED and VALIDATED badges, passed-gate emphasis.

tokens.name: on-ok
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `ok` fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked, failed gate, error, CRITICAL, disconnected, kill switch engaged — an alias of `bear` (the source's CRITICAL alert is `qt-sell`). Always with an icon and a word, so it never reads as SELL.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: BLOCKED badges, critical alert rows.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `danger` fill (the engaged kill switch).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: WAIT_FOR_TRIGGER, APPROVAL_REQUIRED, delayed data, HIGH severity. Dark is the research chart's gold (backtest_standalone.py). Text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `warning` fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational: MEDIUM and LOW alerts, notes — an alias of `accent`, since the source draws its Info icon in cyan.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Plot gridlines as solid 1px hairlines (the source's Recharts grid was dashed, which reads as a threshold). Dark is the source value `#00d9ff20`. Decorative.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis baselines (source axis stroke `#00d9ff40`). Tick labels are text: set them in `ink-muted`, never in this.

tokens.name: chart-price
tokens.usage: The single-series price or equity line, 2px — an alias of `accent` (source line `#00d9ff`).

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First of two compared series: the SMT pair's primary instrument, a strategy line. Validated with `series-2` in both themes (CVD ΔE 13.8 Dark / 14.6 Light).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second compared series: the paired instrument, a comparison — an alias of `accent-alt`. Past two series, facet into small multiples or draw the rest in `chart-muted`.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasized marks: fib levels, benchmark and reference lines (dashed), volume bars. Pine `color.gray`, constant; 4.5:1 on navy, 4.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: level-stop
tokens.usage: Stop / invalidation: the dashed 1px stop line, and the SL key in cards and tickets (text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover`; not on `surface-selected`). Dark is Pine `color.orange`. Always labeled SL.

tokens.name: level-target
tokens.usage: Take-profit levels: dotted TP1/TP3, dashed 2px TP2, and the TP keys in cards and tickets (text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover`; not on `surface-selected`). Dark is Pine `color.blue`. Always labeled TP1–TP3.

groups.name: Terminal
groups.note: Anything a trader scans or compares: symbols, prices, levels, codes, states, labels. Mono keeps digits in columns. Letter-spacing 0.5px, as the source set on body.

styles.name: qe-wordmark
styles.usage: The product wordmark in the header, uppercase, in `accent` (source h1 `text-2xl font-bold`). Nowhere else.

styles.name: qe-price
styles.usage: The one emphasized number in a ticket header or stat tile, in `ink`.

styles.name: qe-control
styles.sample: ES  NQ  GC  SI  SPY  QQQ

styles.name: qe-control-sm
styles.usage: Timeframe segments, buttons, status labels and chart titles (source `text-sm`).

styles.name: qe-data
styles.usage: Values in rows, tickets and alerts; axis ticks (source `text-xs`).

styles.name: qe-label
styles.usage: Field labels, badge text and blocker codes (NO_SMT), uppercase; `ink-muted` for labels, the tone color in badges.

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Anything read as a sentence: reasons, gate evidence, alert messages, notes, education. Added for readability — the terminal set every word in mono.

styles.name: qe-heading
styles.usage: Section headings in reviews, reports and education pages.

styles.name: qe-body
styles.sample: Price swept the overnight low, closed back above it, then displaced through the 5m swing high.
styles.usage: Long-form reading: trade reviews, playbooks, education.

styles.name: qe-body-sm
styles.sample: Paired SMT absent: NQ confirmed the new low with ES.
styles.usage: Reasons, gate evidence, alert messages and empty-state copy inside panels.

spacing.note: The source's Tailwind steps, by their Tailwind names: 2 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24px.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Optical nudge that centers a 14px icon on a 12px line (source `mt-0.5`).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap (source `gap-1`, `mb-1`); vertical padding of small segments (`py-1`).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding in signal and alert items (`p-2`), icon-button padding, gaps between chips (`gap-2`) and list rows (`space-y-2`), vertical padding of segments (`py-2`).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel title to content (`mb-3`), header mark to wordmark (`gap-3`), horizontal padding of small segments (`px-3`).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (`p-4`), the dashboard gutter (`gap-4`), page padding, horizontal padding of segments (`px-4`), header padding and margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Below the control rows, before the grid (`mb-6`); between ticket sections.

radius.note: Nearly square, everywhere: 4px. Round only for status dots.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every rectangle: panels, cards, segments, buttons, badges, tooltips, the scrollbar thumb (source `rounded`).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only (source `rounded-full`).

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows: panels are flat. Only floating layers and focus draw a shadow. The source's glows are listed as legacy.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the ground color, then 2px of solid `accent` (5.3:1 or more on every surface in both themes). Drawn as a box-shadow so it follows `radius`.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: tooltip, menu, popover — always with a `line-control` border.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Legacy — source `.glow-accent` (globals.css). No component uses it; don't glow data, text or panels.

tokens.name: glow-buy
tokens.usage: Legacy — source `.glow-buy`. No component uses it.

tokens.name: glow-sell
tokens.usage: Legacy — source `.glow-sell`. No component uses it.

tokens.name: glow-hover
tokens.usage: Legacy — source `.interactive-hover`. Hover is now `control-hover` plus an `accent` border.

size.note: Fixed sizes the source set in code.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in icon buttons (source `size={20}`).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: The header mark (source `size={24}`).

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: Status dots (source `w-2 h-2`).

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar width and height (globals.css).

tokens.name: chart-height
tokens.usage: Default price-chart plot height (source `height={300}`).

tokens.name: list-max

stroke.note: Chart line widths and dash patterns, carried over from the Pine strategies' level lines.

tokens.name: stroke-price
tokens.usage: Price, equity and series lines (source `strokeWidth={2}`).

tokens.name: stroke-level
tokens.usage: Entry, stop, TP1, TP3 and fib lines (Pine `width=1`).

tokens.name: stroke-level-strong
tokens.usage: TP2, the main target (Pine `width=2`).

tokens.name: dash-dashed
tokens.usage: Stop and TP2 lines, benchmark series (Pine `line.style_dashed`).

tokens.name: dash-dotted
tokens.usage: TP1, TP3 and fib levels (Pine `line.style_dotted`).
